item.title: Implement MCP server for Immich REST API
item.justification: Expose Immich endpoints via MCP using the OpenAPI spec as the source of truth.

security-impact.notes: Handles API tokens/keys and remote API calls; ensure secrets are not logged and TLS is required.

tasks.task: Define configuration inputs (Immich base URL, API key/token)
Ingest the OpenAPI spec and map core endpoints to MCP tools
Add basic error handling and user-facing messages

manual-steps.step: Start the MCP server and list available tools
Invoke one read-only Immich endpoint and verify a successful response

r.observations: Added config-driven Immich HTTP handling, OpenAPI spec fetch, and core MCP tools (ping, server info/version, current user).
r.lessons-learned: Use the raw GitHub URL for JSON specs to avoid HTML responses.

changelog.entry: Added feature item 1: Implement MCP server for Immich REST API.
Items 1 implemented. Added Immich MCP tools, OpenAPI ingestion, and config-driven HTTP handling.
